name: verifa11y-monorepo
description: Audit HTML for accessibility violations, generate a minimal patch per violation, and keep only the patches a re-audit proves correct.

scripts.build: tsc -b packages/core packages/rules-core packages/cli packages/mcp packages/action
scripts.clean: tsc -b --clean packages/core packages/rules-core packages/cli packages/mcp packages/action
scripts.test:sabotage: npm run build && node scripts/test.mjs sabotage
scripts.bench:codemod: npm run build && node packages/cli/dist/cli.js bench --corpus ./corpus --mode codemod --report bench/codemod/report.md --out bench/codemod --notes bench/codemod/analysis.md
scripts.bench: npm run build && node packages/cli/dist/cli.js bench --corpus ./corpus --mode auto --report report.md --out bench/auto --compare bench/codemod/metrics.json
scripts.bench:naive: npm run build && node packages/cli/dist/cli.js bench --corpus ./corpus --mode llm --generator-cmd "node bench/baselines/naive-fixer.mjs" --generator-input json --report bench/baselines/naive/report.md --out bench/baselines/naive --notes bench/baselines/naive/analysis.md --compare bench/codemod/metrics.json
scripts.check:site: npm run build && node scripts/site.mjs check
